sentences.en: JEREMY: Hello, Helen.
sentences.zh: JEREMY: 你好，海伦。

sentences.en: Sorry I'm late.
sentences.zh: 抱歉我来晚了。

sentences.en: HELEN: Hi, Jeremy, no problem.
sentences.zh: HELEN: 嗨，杰里米，没关系。

sentences.en: Well we'd better work out where we are on our project, l suppose.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想我们最好先弄清楚项目目前的进展。

sentences.en: JEREMY: Yeah.
sentences.zh: JEREMY: 是啊。

sentences.en: I've looked at the drawings you've done for my story, 'The Forest', and think they're brilliant - they really create the atmosphere I had in mind when I was writing it.
sentences.zh: 我看了你为我的故事《森林》所绘制的插图，觉得非常棒——它们确实营造出了我在写作时脑海中设想的那种氛围。

sentences.en: HELEN: I'm glad you like them.
sentences.zh: HELEN: 很高兴你喜欢。

sentences.en: JEREMY: There are just a few suggestions I'd like to make.
sentences.zh: JEREMY: 我有几点建议想提一下。

sentences.en: HELEN: Go ahead.
sentences.zh: HELEN: 请讲。

sentences.en: JEREMY: Now, I'm not sure about the drawing of the cave - it's got trees all around it, which is great, but the drawing's a bit too static, isn't it? think it needs some action.
sentences.zh: JEREMY: 嗯，我对那个山洞的插图有点拿不准——山洞四周画满了树木，这点很好，但整幅画显得有点过于静态了，对吧？我觉得需要加入一些动态元素。

sentences.en: Audioscripts
sentences.zh: 听力原文

sentences.en: HELEN: Yes, there's nothing happening.
sentences.zh: HELEN: 是的，画面中没有任何动作发生。

sentences.en: Perhaps I should add the boy - Malcolm, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 也许我该把那个男孩加进去——他叫马尔科姆，对吗？

sentences.en: He would be walking up to it.
sentences.zh: 他正朝山洞走来。

sentences.en: JEREMY: Yes, let's have Malcolm in the drawing.
sentences.zh: JEREMY: 对，就把马尔科姆画进这幅图里。

sentences.en: And what about putting in a tiger the one that he makes friends with a bit later?
sentences.zh: 另外，要不要也把那只老虎加进去？就是他稍后结交的那只。

sentences.en: Maybe it could be sitting under a tree washing itself.
sentences.zh: 或许可以让它坐在一棵树下，正在舔洗自己。

sentences.en: HELEN: And the tiger stops in the middle of what it's doing when it sees Malcolm walking past.
sentences.zh: HELEN: 老虎在舔洗过程中，忽然看见马尔科姆从旁边走过，便停了下来。

sentences.en: JEREMY: That's a good idea.
sentences.zh: JEREMY: 这主意不错。

sentences.en: HELEN: OK, I'll have a go at that.
sentences.zh: HELEN: 好的，我来试试这个构思。

sentences.en: JEREMY: Then there's the drawing of the crowd of men and women dancing.
sentences.zh: JEREMY: 然后是那幅众人跳舞的插图。

sentences.en: They're just outside the forest, and there's a lot going on. a
sentences.zh: 他们就站在森林外边，画面中活动很丰富。

sentences.en: HELEN: That's right, you wanted them to be watching a carnival a procession, but thought it would be too crowded.
sentences.zh: HELEN: 没错，你原本希望他们是在观看一场狂欢节游行，但又担心画面会显得太拥挤。

sentences.en: Do you think it works like this?
sentences.zh: 你觉得现在这样处理效果如何？

sentences.en: JEREMY: Yes, I like what you've done.
sentences.zh: JEREMY: 是的，我很喜欢你的处理方式。

sentences.en: The only thing is, could you add Malcolm to it, without changing what's already there.
sentences.zh: 唯一一点是，能否在不改动现有内容的前提下，把马尔科姆加进去？

sentences.en: HELEN: What about having him sitting on the tree trunk on the right of the picture?
sentences.zh: HELEN: 让他坐在画面右侧的树干上，怎么样？

sentences.en: JEREMY: Yes, that would be fine.
sentences.zh: JEREMY: 好的，这样可以。

sentences.en: HELEN: And do you want him watching the other people?
sentences.zh: HELEN: 你想让他看着其他人吗？

sentences.en: JEREMY: No, he's been left out of all the fun, so I'd like him to be crying - that'll contrast nicely with the next picture, where he's laughing at the clowns in the carnival.
sentences.zh: JEREMY: 不，他被所有欢乐排除在外，所以我希望他正在哭泣——这样能与下一张图形成鲜明对比：在那张图里，他正对着狂欢节上的小丑开怀大笑。

sentences.en: HELEN: Right, I'll do that.
sentences.zh: HELEN: 明白了，我就照这样画。

sentences.en: JEREMY: And then the drawing of the people ice skating in the forest.
sentences.zh: JEREMY: 接着是那幅人们在森林里滑冰的插图。

sentences.en: HELEN: I wasn't too happy with that one.
sentences.zh: HELEN: 那一幅我并不太满意。

sentences.en: Because they're supposed to be skating on grass.
sentences.zh: 因为按设定他们其实是在草地上滑冰。

sentences.en: aren't they?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: JEREMY: That's right, and it's frozen over.
sentences.zh: JEREMY: 没错，而且草地已经冻住了。

sentences.en: At the moment it doesn't look quite right.
sentences.zh: 目前看起来不太对劲。

sentences.en: HELEN: Mm, I see what you mean.
sentences.zh: HELEN: 嗯，我明白你的意思了。

sentences.en: I'll have another go at that.
sentences.zh: 我会重新画这一幅。

sentences.en: JEREMY: And I like the wool hats they're wearing.
sentences.zh: JEREMY: 我很喜欢他们戴的羊毛帽子。

sentences.en: Maybe you could give each of them a scarf, as well.
sentences.zh: 也许你还可以给每人一条围巾。

sentences.en: HELEN: Yeah, that's easy enough.
sentences.zh: HELEN: 是的，这很容易。

sentences.en: They can be streaming out behind the people to suggest they're skating really fast.
sentences.zh: 它们可以飘在人物身后，以表明他们滑得非常快。

sentences.en: JEREMY: Mm, great.
sentences.zh: JEREMY: 嗯，太好了。

sentences.en: Well that's all on the drawings.
sentences.zh: 好了，图纸部分就这些了。

sentences.en: HELEN: Right.
sentences.zh: HELEN: 好的。

sentences.en: So you've finished writing your story and I just need to finish illustrating it, and my story and your drawings are done.
sentences.zh: 所以你已经完成了故事的写作，而我只需完成插图部分；我的故事和你的图画也都已完成。

sentences.en: HELEN: So the next thing iS to decide what exactly we need to write about in the report that goes with the stories, and how we're going to divide the work.
sentences.zh: HELEN: 那么接下来我们需要确定报告中究竟要写哪些内容——这份报告将与我们的故事配套，同时还要决定如何分工。

sentences.en: JEREMY: Right, Helen.
sentences.zh: JEREMY: 好的，海伦。

sentences.en: HELEN: What do you think about including a section on how we planned the project as a whole, Jeremy?
sentences.zh: HELEN: 杰里米，你觉得在报告中加入一个关于整个项目规划过程的章节怎么样？

sentences.en: That's probably quite important.
sentences.zh: 这可能相当重要。

sentences.en: JEREMY: Yeah.
sentences.zh: JEREMY: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, you've had most of the good ideas so far.
sentences.zh: 嗯，到目前为止，大部分好点子都是你提出的。

sentences.en: How do you feel about drafting something, then we can go through it together and discuss it?
sentences.zh: 你是否愿意先起草一份初稿，然后我们再一起通读并讨论？

sentences.en: HELEN: OK, that seems reasonable.
sentences.zh: HELEN: 好的，这看起来很合理。

sentences.en: And I could include something on how we came up with the ideas for our two stories, couldn't l?
sentences.zh: 我还可以加入一些关于我们两个故事创意来源的内容，对吧？

sentences.en: JEREMY: Well I've started writing something about that, so why don't you do the same and we.
sentences.zh: JEREMY: 好吧，我已经开始写这方面的内容了，所以你不如也写一份，我们

sentences.en: can include the two things.
sentences.zh: 可以把这两部分内容都包含进去。

sentences.en: HELEN: Right.
sentences.zh: HELEN: 好的。

sentences.en: So what about our interpretation of the stories?
sentences.zh: 那么，关于我们对这些故事的解读呢？

sentences.en: Do we need to write about what we think they show, like the value of helping other people, all that sort of thing?
sentences.zh: 我们需要写明我们自己认为它们所体现的意义吗？比如助人为乐的价值之类的内容？

sentences.en: JEREMY: That's going to come up later, isn't it?
sentences.zh: JEREMY: 这部分不是要留到后面再讨论吗？

sentences.en: I think everyone in the class is going to read.
sentences.zh: 我觉得班上每个人都会阅读

sentences.en: each other's stories and come up with their own interpretations, which we're going to discuss.
sentences.zh: 彼此写的故事，并提出各自的解读，然后我们再就此展开讨论。

sentences.en: HELEN: Oh, I missed that.
sentences.zh: HELEN: 哦，我漏掉了这一点。

sentences.en: So it isn't going it to be part of the report at all?
sentences.zh: 所以这部分根本不会纳入报告中？

sentences.en: JEREMY: No.
sentences.zh: JEREMY: 是的，不会。

sentences.en: But we need to write about the illustrations, because they're an essential element of children's experience of reading the stories.
sentences.zh: 但我们必须撰写关于插图的部分，因为插图是儿童阅读这些故事时不可或缺的重要元素。

sentences.en: It's probably easiest for you to write that section, as you know more about drawing than I do.
sentences.zh: 这部分由你来写可能最方便，因为你比我更懂绘画。

sentences.en: HELEN: Maybe, but I find it quite hard to write about.
sentences.zh: HELEN: 或许吧，但我发现写这部分还挺难的。

sentences.en: I'd be happier if you did it.
sentences.zh: 如果你来写，我会更安心些。

sentences.en: JEREMY: OK.
sentences.zh: JEREMY: 好的。

sentences.en: So when do you think ...
sentences.zh: 那么，你觉得……
